id.description: JSON object with the descriptor Id. Specify existing descriptor id to update the descriptor. Referencing non-existing descriptor Id will cause error. Omit this field to create new descriptor.

createdTime.description: Timestamp of the descriptor creation, in milliseconds

scope.description: Scope of the Rule Node. Always set to 'TENANT', since no rule chains on the 'SYSTEM' level yet.

clusteringMode.description: Clustering mode of the RuleNode. This mode represents the ability to start Rule Node in multiple microservices.

name.description: Name of the Rule Node. Taken from the @RuleNode annotation.

clazz.description: Full name of the Java class that implements the Rule Engine Node interface.

configurationVersion.description: Rule node configuration version. By default, this value is 0. If the rule node is a versioned node, this value might be greater than 0.

actions.description: Rule Node Actions. Deprecated. Always null.

hasQueueName.description: Indicates that the RuleNode supports queue name configuration.

JsonNode.description: A value representing the any type (object or primitive)
